answer_1.quote: In this paper, we propose to pre-train seq2seq models that aim to capture different linguistic knowledge from input sentences. To build such pre-trained models, we explore three different yet relevant seq2seq tasks, as listed in Table . Here, machine translation acts as the most representative seq2seq task which takes a bilingual dataset as the training data.
answer_1.outputs: The outputs include linearized AMR graphs, syntax sequences, and translated text sequences, depending on the pre-training task.

answer_2.quote: For evaluation purpose, we use the AMR-evaluation toolkit to evaluate parsing performance in Smatch and other fine-grained metrics .
